singleWriterNote: No second store was created. Answers keep living in `interview_questions`, written with the same millisecond-truncated CAS predicate the authenticated writer (`InterviewController.updateQuestion`) uses. The new table is an idempotency/audit ledger, not a parallel answer store.

The identical 6 tests failed with the identical assertion (`expected 503 to be 401`), proving the red is pre-existing and not introduced here.

fixtureIds.determinism: All ids derive from sha256 of a semantic path; no Date.now(), no randomUUID, fixed CF_EPOCH.

negativeControls.authBypassRejected: Unsigned {alg:'none'} token carrying e2e:true → 401. The fixture deletes E2E_MODE and ENABLE_TEST_AUTH_BYPASS at import time.
negativeControls.replaySameKeySamePayload: second call returns replayed:true, exactly 1 receipt row, identical CAS token
negativeControls.changedPayloadCollision: same key + different payload → 409 IDEMPOTENCY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH (not a silent replay)
negativeControls.eightWayRace: 8 concurrent writes of one key → exactly 1 written, rest replayed, exactly 1 receipt row, 0 transport rejections
negativeControls.crossTenantDenial: tenant B's token against tenant A's question returns the SAME status as a nonexistent question (404); response body contains neither the foreign organization id nor the foreign session id
negativeControls.noWriteAfterDenial: tenant A's stored answer verified unchanged after the cross-tenant attempt
negativeControls.completionIdempotent: 6 concurrent /complete calls → exactly 1 transition, status 'completed', completed_at set
negativeControls.noWriteAfterCompletion: 409 DISTRIBUTION_COMPLETED; stored answer and provenance survive a COLD readback on a separate client; zero new receipts
negativeControls.ledgerAppendOnlyInDatabase: direct UPDATE and direct DELETE on the receipt table both refused by trigger; asserted against a NON-EMPTY table so a no-op statement cannot pass the check
negativeControls.piiAndTenantLeak: public GET exposes neither organization id, nor recipientEmail, nor the raw token
negativeControls.zeroResidue: teardown asserts 0 residual rows across distributions/questions/sessions/organizations and throws if any remain

defectsFoundAndFixed.found: Untyped bind parameters (`$n IS NOT NULL`, `trim($n)`) made PostgreSQL fail the whole UPDATE with 42P18 'could not determine data type of parameter', surfacing as an opaque HTTP 500.
A respondent could keep writing AFTER submitting the invite — a submitted response was mutable with no accountable actor.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: New DISTRIBUTION_COMPLETED failure (409), checked inside the FOR UPDATE transaction. Checked in the service rather than the token resolver so the public READ keeps working after submission.

defectsFoundAndFixed.found: The receipt ledger is append-only at the database level, so teardown's DELETE was silently refused and receipts leaked between runs; the first write of the next run then reported `replayed:true`, invalidating every downstream idempotency assertion. Detected only by running the same suite twice.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Teardown uses TRUNCATE (bypasses row triggers, disposable database only) and the suite is verified across two consecutive runs.

defectsFoundAndFixed.found: `ON DELETE CASCADE` into an append-only table makes the parent undeletable and reports a misleading 'append-only' error on an unrelated DELETE.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: FK changed to ON DELETE RESTRICT, which states the real rule: a used invite cannot be deleted.

rollback.method: Revert the package commit. The migration is additive and forward-only (new nullable column, new table, new index, new trigger); old readers are unaffected and no existing row is rewritten. Dropping the two routes removes the only writers of the new table.
